sources.title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
sources.snippet: We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image.
